intervals.label: operating
intervals.note: MPIK, 27.10.2025: "on Oct 26th KATRIN accomplished its goal of 1000 measurement days of probing the endpoint region of the tritium beta-decay spectrum with unprecedented sensitivity, marking the completion of its neutrino-mass data taking." The KIT workshop abstract of April 2026 agrees: "After 1000days of measurement and 19 campaigns, the data taking was concluded in October 2025."
intervals.quote: 36 million electrons collected in 259 measurement days

intervals.label: TRISTAN phase: commissioning of the new detector system
intervals.locator: DEIB (Politecnico di Milano) news item, 27 May 2026; MPIK news item of 18.04.2026 (caption: "launching KATRIN++ and TRISTAN with a ceremonial button press")
intervals.note: Start is the April 2026 symposium at which the TRISTAN phase was inaugurated (17 April 2026); the technical start of commissioning is not dated by any fetched source. MPIK (27.10.2025): "Starting in 2026, a new detector system, TRISTAN, will be installed"; MPIK (18.04.2026): "preparations for the TRISTAN upgrade are already opening new opportunities". No interval is recorded between the end of neutrino-mass data taking (2025-10-26) and this start: no fetched source dates the installation work. The neutrino-mass analysis of the full 1000-day data set continues.
intervals.quote: celebrated the achievement of 1,000 days of neutrino measurements with the inauguration of phase 2 of the project: the commissioning of a new and more sophisticated detector, TRISTAN.

placements.quote: the KArlsruhe TRItium Neutrino (KATRIN) experiment, which is presently being performed at Tritium Laboratory Karlsruhe on the KIT Campus North site

summary.plain: A huge tube-shaped spectrometer that sorts electrons by their energy, precisely measuring the fastest ones released when radioactive tritium gas decays, to work out how heavy the neutrino can be.
summary.technical: MAC-E (Magnetic Adiabatic Collimation with Electrostatic) filter spectrometer fed by a windowless gaseous molecular tritium source (WGTS), analysing the endpoint region of the tritium beta-decay spectrum.

technology.quote: performs precision spectroscopy of the tritium β-decay close to the kinematic endpoint
technology.value: MAC-E filter electrostatic/magnetic spectrometer with a windowless gaseous tritium source
